name: intelligent-automotive-diagnostics
description: TFM - Vehicular telemetry simulation & AI-powered diagnosis using MCP

scripts.predev:all: sh -c 'for p in 4000 5173; do pids=$(lsof -ti:${p} 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids 2>/dev/null; echo "[predev:all] puerto $p liberado (PID(s): $pids)"; else fuser -k ${p}/tcp 2>/dev/null && echo "[predev:all] puerto $p liberado (fuser)" || echo "[predev:all] puerto $p ya estaba libre"; fi; done' || true
scripts.verify: pnpm lint:all && pnpm format && pnpm format:ui && pnpm test:all && pnpm build && pnpm build:ui && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:ui
